items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: my aunt was married to my uncle Will, Daddy’s brother.

ctx.x: Were you named after any of your relatives?

No, I don’t know why I was named Margaret Marian. I really don’t know. I can remember some . . . I can’t remember anybody in my family being named Margaret, actually. Or my sister either, like Joyce Kathleen, maybe there was a cousin or my mother’s or a friend name Kathleen. Mabel was . . . my aunt was married to my uncle Will, Daddy’s brother. Her name was Mabel. I don’t know if Joyce was named after her. I don’t know. It’s so funny, all those names. In fact I have a running joke with Bobby Short, because I…
Also, so you decided very early, either professionally or otherwise, to be known by your middle name?
